details.overview: a fully custom headless storefront for lala blue — elika's independent fashion label. shopify runs the backend; everything the customer touches is bespoke.
details.role:
freelance — full ownership from first call to launch and beyond: ideation, design, creative direction, development, and the dns migration to lalablue.com.

shopify storefront api drives products, cart, and checkout. flodesk handles marketing email; web3forms powers the contact form.

built a custom cms behind a password-protected admin route so the client updates content herself — no developer in the loop.

continuously tuned for seo and aeo/geo. i own and maintain the site, meeting with the client regularly and iterating on feedback.

typography-first warm minimalism.

the work grid intentionally hides images behind warm color blocks to move away from the 'instagram feed' pattern where competing images dilute attention.

inspired by editorials.

details.overview: an image analysis & value-reference tool that extracts 'n'-values from a reference image, renders a palette, and maps them across the original image.
details.role:
a project for artists first; not an algorithm demo.

the value palette is constrained to drawing conventions (values: 3, 5, 7, 9 — up to 15), rather than chasing a pixel-perfect granularity palette that no artist would actually use.

tested histogram, k-means, and otsu segmentation — eye-test wins over quantitative metrics since this is a visual aid for artists.
